summary: Improve referral follow-up, frontline supervision and programme review skills. Explore the five-day community health systems course.
lede: Community health systems strengthening coordinates people, services, relationships and information linking communities with the wider health system. For programme officers, supervisors and technical advisers, it builds practical skills to map referral pathways, assess workforce support and review routine data so they can identify service gaps and agree feasible improvements with community and service stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape or support community health delivery and need to improve the links between households, community health workers and facilities.
audience: Community Health Monitoring and Evaluation Officers
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with community health, primary health care or public health programme delivery. Coding is not required; basic spreadsheet use is helpful for the routine-data exercise.
